content: Current CRAN versions (2026): rmarkdown 2.32 (2026-09-01), knitr 1.52 (2026-09-06), tinytex 0.60 (2026-06-16), officedown 0.4.1 (2025-05-20), officer 0.7.6 (2026-07-16). rmarkdown already in EventStudy Suggests. knitr already in EventStudy Suggests. tinytex would be a new Suggests entry for PDF detection. officedown/officer are optional heavy additions — avoid unless bookdown-style cross-references needed. pandoc is a system-level requirement (not an R package), documented in SystemRequirements.
